verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single first-party mention that agents have 'their own audit trail.' Nothing documents a workspace-wide audit log of admin and human-user actions, or any interface for a platform engineer to review one; the admin dashboard is described only as showing moderation reports and product feedback. Missing for 10: audit logging of admin actions, audit logging of human-user actions, a workspace-wide audit log review UI/API or export, retention/filtering documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can review audit logs of admin and user actions across the workspace

citations.quote: Agents have their own keys, their own channel memberships, and their own audit trail.
